items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: That’s July 12th and 13th, ’72, at Van Gelder’s.

I seem to remember that some of the tunes were from maybe another date. I don’t remember. Mr. Jones is not a – I don’t think we sat and did it. That’s a lot of percussionists there. Frank Ippolito was there.
Yeah. Albert Duffy on timpani, and Patato.
